title: Overexposed Secret
description: secret.env is owned by the current user but is readable and writable by everyone.
mission: Restrict secret.env so only its owner can read and write it (mode 0600).
success: The secret file is restricted to its owner.

lesson.what_happened: Group and other permission bits exposed a sensitive file.
lesson.be_careful: Changing ownership usually requires elevated privileges; fix only what the mission requires.

hints: Inspect ownership and all permission bits with ls -l.
The owner needs rw; group and others need no access.

ja.title: 公開されすぎたsecret
ja.description: secret.envが全userから読み書き可能になっています。
ja.mission: ownerだけが読み書きできるmode 0600へ制限してください。
ja.success: secret fileをownerだけに制限できました。

lesson.what_happened: groupとotherのpermissionによりsensitive fileが公開されていました。
lesson.be_careful: ownership変更は通常権限が必要です。Missionに必要な範囲だけ直しましょう。
